hero.title: How EPEW Works
hero.subtitle: The Official EPEW Development Process
hero.imageAlt: How EPEW Helps Entrepreneurs Build Real Businesses

step1.title: The Entrepreneur Brings the Idea
step1.description: Every successful business begins with an idea. The entrepreneur brings the vision, passion, and determination to build something meaningful.

step2.title: EPEW Develops the Idea
step2.description: EPEW develops the idea into a structured business opportunity through education, coaching, planning, professional guidance, and business development.

step3.title: EPEW Prepares the Entrepreneur and Connects Funding
step3.description: EPEW prepares the entrepreneur for business ownership, funding readiness, and connects them with the funding needed to launch and grow.

step4.title: EPEW Provides the Entrepreneur Development Ecosystem
step4.description: The EDE brings together coaches, professional teams, Founding Supporters, Certified Growth Partners, technology, and coordinated resources into one complete support system.

step5.title: IBOS Coordinates the Journey
step5.description: IBOS coordinates preparation, professional services, business development, milestones, communications, service requests, funding readiness, and long-term business growth.

epew.title: EPEW
epew.subtitle: The Organization
epew.text: EPEW establishes the entrepreneurship mission, standards, programs, community participation, and governance that guide the entrepreneur’s journey.

ede.title: EDE
ede.subtitle: The Ecosystem
ede.text: The Enterprise Development Environment brings together coaches, partners, vendors, supporters, professional services, and resources needed to develop the business.

ibos.title: IBOS
ibos.subtitle: The Operating System
ibos.text: IBOS coordinates the entrepreneur’s operational journey, workflows, milestones, communications, services, funding readiness, and long-term business development.

cta.title: One Ecosystem. Clear Steps. Shared Growth.
cta.description: EPEW helps entrepreneurs move from idea to structure, from preparation to funding readiness, and from business launch to long-term growth.
